llm.summary: The skill's stated purpose (generate and send mood music via MiniMax to Feishu) is plausible, but the runtime instructions require external credentials, a CLI, and local logging that are not declared in the registry metadata and include automatic triggers for extreme emotional language without escalation — these inconsistencies warrant caution.

dimensions.detail: The SKILL.md and Python script clearly depend on the MiniMax service (mmx-cli or MINIMAX_API_KEY) and write local logs; the registry metadata declares no required env vars or binaries. MiniMax credentials and a CLI are legitimate needs for music generation, but the manifest omission is a meaningful mismatch.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

dimensions.detail: Instructions tell the agent to install and use mmx-cli,/or call scripts that read MINIMAX_API_KEY, construct prompts, download audio, send files via a 'message' tool, and optionally persist mood history to memory/mood-music-log.json. These actions are within the skill's purpose but include automatic Level-3 triggers on extreme phrases (including self-harm language) with no escalation path, and they direct the agent to read/write local files not declared in metadata.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: There is no formal install spec in the manifest (instruction-only), but SKILL.md instructs users to run 'npm install -g mmx-cli' (linking to GitHub). This is a standard npm install from a referenced project and not inherently high-risk, but the manifest should declare this dependency for transparency.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: The included script requires MINIMAX_API_KEY (read from env) and the instructions also mention mmx auth (API key or OAuth). The registry lists no required env variables or primary credential — this missing declaration is a proportionality/visibility problem. Also the skill will store local emotion logs (privacy-sensitive data) which should be disclosed and protected.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: always is false and the skill does not request system-wide privileges. It does write files locally (/tmp/openclaw and memory/mood-music-log.json) which is reasonable for caching/history but is a persistence choice users should be aware of. It does not attempt to modify other skills or global configs.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

llm.guidance: Before installing: (1) Expect to provide a MiniMax API key or use mmx-cli — the manifest does not declare this, so treat it as required and keep the key secret. (2) Verify the mmx-cli source (https://github.com/MiniMax-AI/cli) yourself and confirm you trust the MiniMax service and its privacy/usage policies. (3) Confirm how the agent's 'message' tool sends to Feishu and which Feishu credentials/permissions are used — the skill does not declare or show Feishu auth. (4) Be aware the skill writes a local mood history (memory/mood-music-log.json) containing sensitive emotional data; decide whether that storage is acceptable and who can access it. (5) The skill auto-triggers on extreme emotion phrases (including language suggesting self-harm) but gives no escalation or safety procedure; if you will expose this to users, add a safe-handling flow (e.g., escalation to human moderators or crisis resources) and restrict auto-triggering. (6) Ask the publisher to update the skill manifest to list required env vars (MINIMAX_API_KEY), binaries (mmx-cli), and any config paths so you can assess permissions accurately.
